# Backlog

Everything wanted but not yet planned into a phase, most important first. When a phase is planned, its items move from here into the phase plan and keep their IDs.

- New ideas from the operator, bugs and chores found along the way, and review findings that can wait all land here.
- Write each entry in the item format from `docs/rules/workflow.md`. A one-line entry is fine until it is planned, but it needs acceptance checks before it moves into a phase.
- Reorder freely. Never reuse an ID. Mark dropped entries `[-]` with the reason.
